summary: Centers page content at a max width from the size scale with token side padding. Phones always get a 16px gutter.
whenToUse: The outer wrapper of a page or a page section.
sm for forms and reading (keeps lines under about 75 characters), lg for settings, xl for dashboards and tables.
render={<main />} on the page's main region.
whenNotToUse: Inside cards or dialogs: they already set their width and padding.
Full-bleed backgrounds: put the background on an outer element and the Container inside it.

dos.title: Match the width to the content
dos.text: Forms in an xl container stretch inputs to unreadable lengths. Pick sm.

donts.title: Nested containers
donts.text: A container inside a container doubles the padding and adds nothing.

accessibility: A plain div by default; render as <main /> for the main region so the landmark exists.
Content reflows at 320px wide without horizontal scroll (WCAG 1.4.10).
contentGuidelines: Not applicable: Container holds no copy of its own.
